source: USITC HTS Rev18 (2026-09-02) + USTR forced-labour determinations (eff 2026-07-24) + Section 232 (pharma 2026-09-29 / drones 2026-09-03 / polysilicon 2026-12-04) + UK EPS deal. Re-verified live 2026-09-03.
notes: Forced-labour Section 301 (eff 2026-07-24) replaced the expired Section 122 10% surcharge. 46 economies at 12.5%, others at 10%.

EU goods: operative forced-labour Section 301 ceiling is 10% (per USTR/Business Sweden 2026-08-27). The separate 'US-EU 15% all-inclusive deal' was the IEEPA reciprocal framework invalidated by SCOTUS, so it no longer adds a separate tariff; EU = MFN + forced-labour 301 (capped 10%) + Section 232 if applicable. UK frozen at 10% under the Economic Prosperity Deal.
USMCA-qualifying MX/CA goods are exempt from the MFN base and forced-labour duty; Section 232 still applies to metals/autos.
Section 232 (steel/alum/copper 50%, autos 25%, lumber 10%) was unaffected by the SCOTUS IEEPA ruling; pharma 100% eff 2026-09-29, drones 100% eff 2026-09-03, polysilicon +15% eff 2026-12-04.
China-specific Section 301 (List 4A 7.5% via 9903.88.15) STACKS on top of the forced-labour 12.5%.
